title: Wilde Buckaroo Touring Bar
content:
Wilde Bikes once again team up with the legends at S&M BMX to fabricate a new bar called the Buckaroo Bar. The goal was to find that sweet spot between comfort and control. The result is a bar with a bit of flex, a bit of rise, and just the right amount of backsweep…

“Made in USA” and “Wilde Bicycle Co.” are stamped into the steel, but the Wilde logo is just a decal on top of the finish. The clamp diameter is 22.2, so you will need shims if you’re planning on using a 25.4, 26.0, or 31.8 clamp stem. Our recommendation for 22.2 bars is the 7/8″ Paul Boxcar stem. That stem seems to be one of the only ones to resist 22.2 bar slippage.

Specs

  • 50mm Rise
  • 45° Back Sweep
  • 800 mm Wide
  • 22.2 mm Clamp
  • Weight: 713 g
  • Material: Chromoly Steel
  • Made in the USA by S&M

Check out more at Wilde Bikes.
